name: neon-market
description: NEON MARKET — food marketplace: React client + Node.js API

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
